questions.stem: A 65-year-old CEO of a MNC received a severe blow on his head that caused a depressed fracture of his frontal bone. He was admitted in the hospital and discharged after 72 hours of observation. He joined his duty but in a few days the office staff noticed that CEO’s social behaviour has changed dramatically. He no more dresses himself properly and lacks initiative and drive. He also lacked inhibition and one day he was seen urinating in the dustbin of his office. Which part of the brain is most likely affected?
